name: CORPONATION FUTURES EXCHANGE: Dark Pool Edition
description: Operating as a nominally legal prediction market registered in a Sable Charter gray zone, the Dark Pool Edition of the CFE allows verified participants to bet on corponation stock movements, merger announcements, product launch outcomes, and executive departures — with the significant difference that Dark Pool positions are fully anonymous and unregulated by standard Meridian financial oversight. Minimum buy-in is steep, but positions can be leveraged up to 40:1 against underlying Quanta reserves. The platform is technically incorporated on a floating server cluster in Lake Michigan, beyond municipal jurisdiction.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 accountant stumbles onto a Dark Pool position so large it could only represent advance knowledge of a corponation collapse — and the position is in their name.
A runner is hired to physically destroy the Lake Michigan server cluster before a regulatory team can seize it, but discovers the cluster contains far more than financial records.
Two rival corponation intelligence arms are both trying to identify the same anonymous Dark Pool whale — and they've both hired the same fixer without knowing it.
